A shared syntax makes diagrams easy to revise

flowchart LR
  accTitle: The deck authoring loop
  accDescr: Write slides, build the deck, preview it, and return to writing.
  A[Write slides] --> B[Build deck]
  B --> C[Preview]:::highlight
  C --> A
  B --> D[Share HTML]:::muted

Preview updates follow each save

sequenceDiagram
  accTitle: Preview rebuild sequence
  accDescr: The author saves slides, the builder returns HTML, and the browser reloads.
  participant A as Author
  participant B as Builder
  participant P as Preview
  A->>B: Save slides
  B->>P: Updated HTML
  P-->>A: Reload browser
  Note over B,P: No remote resources

Diagrams inherit slide-local brand colours

flowchart LR
  accTitle: Approval process
  accDescr: A draft is reviewed, revised if necessary, and published after approval.
  A[Draft] --> B{Approved?}:::highlight
  B -->|Yes| C[Publish]
  B -->|No| D[Revise]:::muted
  D --> A

Dark diagrams keep labels and emphasis readable

flowchart LR
  accTitle: Offline deck assembly
  accDescr: The build combines slide source, engine, and optional libraries into one HTML file.
  A[Slides] --> D[Single HTML file]:::highlight
  B[Engine] --> D
  C[Optional libraries]:::muted --> D

Existing libraries still render on hidden slides
